## Privacy notice

This is a static website. It sets **no cookies** and uses **no third-party trackers**.

**What is collected.** Nothing beyond aggregate, anonymous visit statistics (page views and referrers), if analytics are enabled at all. These figures cannot identify you and are not linked to any other data.
<!-- TODO(senne): if you enable GoatCounter/Plausible, name it here; if not, delete the "if analytics are enabled" clause. -->

**What is not collected.** No account, no contact form, no advertising or profiling. If you email me, I keep your message and reply; I do not use it for anything else.

**Your rights.** Under the GDPR you may ask what data I hold about you, ask me to correct or delete it, or object to its use. Contact me at the address above.
